main_objective: Compare source-faithful, natural prose generation across independent source-passage families, with example retrieval vs plain rewriting; fidelity and owner naturalness outrank detector pass.
design_rationale: V1 semantic-dossier baselines failed fidelity in 3/3. V2 exact-source baselines passed 3/3 but nonrestricted CLI inherited very large context; first revisions often added rhetorical aftercare or lost claims. V3 uses Claude restricted mode verified on static smoke with ~443 input tokens and no project settings/tools/memory, separate processes and workspaces, the baseline prose rather than the source-function checklist as writing substrate.

cases.baseline_detector: Pangram 4.1 AI/high; known diagnostic, not blind holdout

engine.freshness: separate process and per-stage empty working directory; explicit lean system prompt, no project/user/local auto-settings
engine.stability_check: static restricted mode 443 input tokens on test, no preloaded 94k cached project context; counts to be measured per task

stages.source: Exact registered source paragraph; nearby context only as needed for referent; output only new model-written faithful single paragraph
stages.on_error: fidelity fail -> stop case and preserve

stages.source: Original exact source and baseline, no Pangram labels, independent stage context
Common admitted model baseline, no teacher, no source text, one paragraph or unchanged
Same baseline and restrictions, plus exactly one preassigned literal cross-article teaching pair; no target/source leakage
Original source, anonymous A/B outputs, no teacher, no detector labels; assess meaning, rhetoric and voice separately

output_format: single paragraph, no headings/bullets/multi-para or extra JSON in generation outputs
acceptance: Any missing actor/claim, changed certainty, invented rationale/example, lost humor, added clinical/medical advice or switch to multiple paragraphs disqualifies first-pass joint quality; retain all failed candidates.
analysis: Descriptive only; 6 cases from 6 article clusters, one author; prior T13 detector known, no independent 6-case accuracy extrapolation. Categorize voice preference and fidelity separately. Only meaning-approved, decision-relevant future Pangram calls, one to three paragraphs with exact cached result.
